notes.content: DIVERSITY REQUIREMENT FOR CAL STATE LA GRADUATION

The articulation information in Assist.org not only shows a link to the admission requirements (aka our Major Specific Criteria webpage) but also Cal State LA graduation requirements that may be completed at the lower-division level, prior to transferring to the University. The diversity requirement is a graduation requirement , not an admission requirement. The diversity requirement may be completed prior to, or after, transferring to the University. For the Cal State LA degree, students will be required to complete two courses (six units) certified as diversity courses, at least one focusing on issues of race and ethnicity and their intersectionality with other social categories that structure inequality in society. These courses can be completed either at the lower-division or upper-division level from among courses satisfying GE requirements. Please view the General Education agreements on Assist.org for the lower-division courses that will meet the Diversity (d) and Race & Ethnicity (re) Requirements.

notes.content: The Bachelor of Science degree in Public Health prepares students for leadership and education roles in community health and other public health careers as well as for graduate study. Requirements for the Degree The total number of units required for the Bachelor of Science degree in Public Health is 120 units, of which 55 units are in the major. The Public Health major’s curriculum includes lower and upper-division core courses (46 units) and directed electives (9 units, must select at least 6 units in Public Health). Consult with an advisor for the specific number of units required in all areas of the degree including GE and free electives. See the Undergraduate Studies: General Information for details about the General Education and other requirements that constitute the units outside the major. A minimum C grade is required in all courses used to meet major requirements.

  • Consult with an advisor for the specific number of units required in all areas of the degree including GE and free electives. See the Undergraduate Studies: General Information for details about the General Education and other requirements that constitute the units outside the major.
  • A minimum C grade is required in all courses used to meet major requirements.
